Priya: Quick heads-up  Cerulean Capital renewed their Dedicated contract via the AWS Marketplace Private Offer and expanded usage into eu-west-1. Signed at 10:05 UTC. :tada:
Noah: Fantastic news! Any numbers on the renewal delta or unit economics?
Aisha: Renewal increased committed spend by ~40%. They reported a ~3x reduction in token spend on their fraud-detection pipeline after switching to our int8 quantized endpoints + KV prefix caching.
BillingBot: invoice/cerulean/renewal-2026 issued at 10:07:12 (amount: EUR 180,000) :receipt:
Priya: They also requested a short renewal quote and a marketplace case blurb. Can Comms own the outreach?
Comms: On it. I'll request a 1-2 sentence quote and confirm logo usage. Please drop a 1-pager with perf numbers/config here (no PHI).
Aisha: Dropping perf bullets: p95 latency for scoring calls ~95ms at 300 req/s; batching: latency-aware; model: redwood-gpt-13b-1.2; quantization: int8; kv_cache: prefix.
Noah: Legal: confirm the public quote permissions and any marketplace listing updates required.
Legal: Please use the standard permission template. Once they sign, we can push the renewal case to the Marketplace tile and the partner portal.
Priya: Thanks team  big win for renewals & marketplace motion. I'll post a short note to #all-hands after we get written permission. :clap:
